item.title: Dead Bodies, Guns, & Prostitution Rings: Stories from a Realtor [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

This week was a family episode! Just Greg and the Dead Heads! As many listeners know, Greg is a Real Estate Broker servicing Michigan and Ohio. Greg told stories of his early real estate career working in Detroit, MI. It included guns being pulled on him, breaking up an illegal prostitution ring, and stumbling upon dead bodies. By the providence of God he was kept safe, and learned alot! Enjoy this odd, but entertaining episode!

item.title: Frog & Fable: Smoking Pipe Tobacco for the Glory of God [Dead Men Walking Podcast]
item.description:
Send us a text

This week Greg sat down with owners Jared and Seth of Frog & Fable Tobacco. They specialize in American grown pipe tobacco, and are quickly expanding. The boys discussed the growing pains of a new start up, different tobacco profiles and flavors, as well as techniques and best practices. If you partake in the pipe or cigar, or if you're thinking about it, this is the episode for you! Enjoy!
